_comment: Lighting parameters for Blender Cycles rendering of the ADT Apartment scene.
Edit these values to tune brightness/colour without touching Python code.
Ceiling energy calibration reference:
egocentric — tuned so render mean matches ADT synthetic (≈61) after Aria ISP.
exocentric — lower ceiling (actual geometry height) and lower energy for
third-person views that are not ISP-corrected to Aria output.
Tune with: python calibrate_lighting.py --mode ego/exo

prop_lights._comment: Physical lamp props found in scene_objects.csv by name prefix.

_comment: 30 AREA lights on a 5×6 grid covering the full apartment floor plan.
Grid redesigned for uniform 1.5 m spacing in both X and Z so that
ALL rooms (kitchen, living room, bedroom) receive equal illumination.
Apartment floor extent from mesh analysis:
Key coverage vs old grid:
Bedroom (Z -3.82 to -0.20): now 3 lights (Z=-3.5, -2.0, -0.5) vs 2 before.
Bedroom centre Z=-2.01 now has a panel directly above it (was uncovered).
Kitchen/living (Z 0 to 5): 4 lights (Z=-0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 4.0) vs 4 before.
Removed Z=5.0 and Z=7.5 (both outside apartment ceiling area).
Total panels: 5 x 6 = 30 (same count, so no energy re-calibration needed).
Adjacent tiles overlap by ~2 m so there is no hotspot banding.
Panels are hidden from the camera ray (visible_camera=False in
blender_render_scene.py) to avoid bright-patch artefacts on the ceiling.

egocentric._comment: CEIL_Y raised to 3.3 m (above true ceiling) to brighten narrow FOV ego views.

exocentric._comment: CEIL_Y at 2.45 m (just below 2.5 m ceiling) for wide third-person views.
